# Allstate Spray Foam Roofing — Fresno

> Commercial spray foam (SPF) roofing and silicone roof coating contractor serving
> Fresno and California's Central Valley — Fresno, Clovis, Madera, Visalia, Tulare,
> Hanford, Merced, and Bakersfield. Family-owned, 20+ years in business, California
> Contractors License #C-2-1052735, SPFA member. Commercial roofing division of
> Allstate Spray Foam Insulation (allstatesprayfoam.com). Not affiliated with
> Allstate Insurance or Allstate Roofing Company.

Key facts:
- Services: new SPF (spray polyurethane foam) roof systems, silicone roof coatings
  and restoration, foam roof repair, commercial insulation
- Buildings: warehouses, agricultural processing and packing facilities, cold
  storage, metal buildings, retail centers, office parks, schools and churches
- Typical installed cost: $4-$8/sq ft for new SPF roof systems; $2-$4/sq ft to
  recoat an existing foam roof (free written bid within 48 hours)
- SPF insulates at ~R-6.5 per inch — the highest R-value of any roof system —
  and installs over most existing metal, built-up, and concrete roofs with no tear-off
- Roof life: recoat the silicone topcoat every 10-20 years to renew the system
  indefinitely; SPF roofs 30+ years old routinely test like new underneath
- Free roof assessment: drone survey + core sampling where needed + written bid in 48 hours
- Phone: (559) 739-9519 · Hours: Mon-Sat 8:00-17:00

- [Spray Polyurethane Foam Roofing](https://fresnosprayfoamroofing.com/spray-polyurethane-foam-roofing): How SPF roof systems work — seamless, self-flashing, insulating
